svg.aria-label: Roadmap: from the unreleased work proposed as 0.14.0 on main, the ten majors are 0.15.0 Durable Spine, 0.16.0 Recoverable Jobs, 0.17.0 Governed Organization, 0.18.0 Review And Ship, 0.19.0 Accountable Operations, 1.0.0 Release Evidence (the compatibility and trust promise), 1.1.0 Measured Value, 1.2.0 The Agent Surface, 1.3.0 Causal Record and 1.4.0 Scale What Wins.
